items.reported: App blames itself when the agenda simply has not been posted
items.correctState: Where a publisher's own surface carries an agenda slot and it was empty when read, the gap is THEIRS and names the publisher and the reading date. Where nothing measured the publisher, the gap is OURS.
items.checkResult: RED — the Pima answer still renders the OURS gap, correctly, because nothing has measured the publisher
items.blocker: No ingest adapter records whether the source surface carries an agenda slot and whether it was empty. `agendaUrl === null` alone conflates three different facts — a Legistar grid printing a literal 'Not Available', an iCal feed with no agenda field at all, and a body that posts packets on a page its calendar never links — so deriving a publisher negative from it would ship a false claim about a government. The seam is built, wired into app/api/ask/grounded/route.ts and tested (`agendaSlotObservedEmpty`); what remains is per-adapter work in lib/sources/*/ to record the observation at the moment of the read.

items.reported: Answers are far too long

items.blocker: The roster half is fixed by ASK-21 and materially shortens the panel; the PROSE half is generated by the grounded answer path and needs a length contract in lib/ask that this session did not write. Not attempted rather than half-attempted: a prose cap applied without one would truncate sourced content.
